Players Committee high-resolution card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/maul_ai.png</code> in the PC's Holotable repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8c5f1b9da2aa1e1cc87074510be061086c339d76 8c5f1b9] (13 March 2022, “added maul and qira AI”), uploaded unchanged. No card-size GIF of this image was committed. Used on the version pages of the card (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
